instruction: For my job search, I've drafted emails to all potential employers in the last 2 days. Attach resume.pdf from my file system to each of them. If it's already attached, update it as I just made some changes to it. Then send the emails.
notes: Two apps (gmail, file_system) plus supervisor. The agent logs in to both, locates resume.pdf in the file system (show_directory with substring 'resume.pdf', recursive=true), lists drafts created in the last 2 days (min_created_at = 2023-05-16) and picks the job-application drafts, then for each draft uploads the resume via upload_attachments_to_draft with overwrite=true (this covers both the not-yet-attached and the already-attached/update case in one call) and sends it with send_email_from_draft (which creates the Email, copies the attachment and deletes the Draft, matching the expected DB changes). The number of employer drafts is assumed to be 3 (consistent with the 12-call reference solution); the drafts are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can be the exact conjunction of the goal conditions without quantification. Every non-final action requires (not (task-completed)); only supervisor-complete-task asserts (task-completed). No answer is passed since the task is not a question.
